analysis.scenarios:
Bull / Base / Bear with probabilities:
Bull case (probability ~0.45): Copper price breakout, real-money net buying returns, TEDPIX breadth positive with volume, fund rotation to commodity leaders, geopolitical de-escalation (Hormuz risk fades)
Base case (probability ~0.40): Steady sales growth (100%+ YoY), stable commodity prices, controlled geopolitical tension, FX regime managed
Bear case (probability ~0.15): Copper price breakdown, volume collapse, real-money outflow accelerates, US-Iran conflict / Hormuz closure risk, gasoline price hike → inflation → rate hike
Probabilities sum to 1.0 (0.45 + 0.4 + 0.15 = 1.0)

Confidence: 🟡 medium (insufficient evidence lowers confidence rather than fabricating precision)

Key triggers for Bull: Copper price >$4.50/lb, real-money inflow ≥3 sessions, TEDPIX breadth >600 advancers
Key triggers for Bear: Copper <$3.50/lb, real-money outflow accelerates, industry relative strength deteriorates, equal-weight index leads down

Invalidation signals: Price rises while real-money flow deteriorates, sales growth rolls over 2 consecutive releases, copper breaks down materially
